title: Disney Through the Decades
intro: Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! [excited] Today we're hopping in the time machine and taking a trip through nearly one hundred years of Disney history. Fasten your seatbelts, and please keep your arms inside the decade at ALL times. [laughs]

art.prompt: A glowing retro time-machine archway on a stage with a spiral of floating vintage objects from every decade: a 1920s gramophone, a 1950s jukebox, a 1980s cassette, a 1990s CRT TV and a modern tablet, film reels unspooling across a starry sky, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Whistle While You Work
categories.intro: Where else could a trip through the decades start? [excited] With the very first Disney animated feature, 1937's Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs!

art.prompt: A cozy storybook cottage in a sunlit enchanted forest, a wishing well in front, a basket of shiny red apples, seven tiny pickaxes leaning by the door and diamonds sparkling from a mine entrance, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Snow White takes one bite of this poisoned fruit and falls into a deep sleep.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an apple. [chuckles] Lesson learned, kids: never take produce from a stranger with a cackle.

clues.clue: This dwarf never says a single word in the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dopey! He doesn't talk, but he's got the best ears and the best dance moves in the cottage.

clues.clue: The Queen orders the Huntsman to bring back this in a box as proof that Snow White is gone.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is her heart. The Huntsman swapped it for a pig's heart instead. [gasps] Dark stuff for 1937!

clues.clue: Snow White sings this song into the wishing well right before the Prince appears.
choices: With a Smile and a Song
clues.reveal: The correct answer is I'm Wishing! The Prince answers with One Song. [laughs] Smooth move, your highness.

clues.clue: Walt Disney's special honorary Oscar for Snow White came with one full-size statuette and this many miniature ones.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is seven! One for each dwarf. Shirley Temple handed it to Walt in 1939. The CUTEST trophy in Hollywood history.

categories.title: What Decade Is It?
categories.intro: [excited] Hop in the time machine! I'll name a big Disney milestone. You tell me the decade it happened in.

art.prompt: A wall of giant retro flip calendars and spinning clock faces from different eras, confetti-colored decade banners, a sepia-to-color gradient sweeping across the scene, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Mickey Mouse whistles his way into history in Steamboat Willie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the 1920s! November 18th, 1928, to be exact. [laughs] Happy birthday, Mickey!

clues.clue: Disneyland opens its gates in Anaheim, California.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the 1950s! July 17th, 1955. Opening day was so chaotic, the press called it... [dramatic pause] Black Sunday.

clues.clue: Toy Story becomes the first feature film made entirely with computer animation.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the 1990s! 1995. To infinity and beyond, and also, to an entire new art form.

clues.clue: The Little Mermaid makes a splash and kicks off the Disney Renaissance.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the 1980s! It came out in November 1989, so it just snuck in. [mischievously] Gotcha if you said the 90s!

clues.clue: Fantasia premieres, with its own special Fantasound stereo system.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the 1940s! November 1940. [chuckles] Walt was doing surround sound before most people owned a radio worth listening to.

categories.title: Fashion Through the Decades
categories.intro: It's the media category! I'll show you the colours of a famous outfit and drop the decade it debuted. You name the character wearing it. [whispers] No fashion police allowed.

art.prompt: A sparkling runway lined with empty dress forms wearing outfits from every era: a 1920s red-and-yellow look, a 1950s silver-blue ball gown, a 1990s cowboy vest and a jeweled modern costume, paint swatches and color chips floating in the air, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: 1920s: Big black ears, bright red shorts, yellow shoes and white gloves.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey Mouse! Nearly a hundred years later, he still hasn't changed his shorts. [laughs] Iconic... if a little concerning.

clues.clue: 1950s: A shimmering silvery blue ball gown, a black choker and a blonde updo.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella! Bibbidi-bobbidi-blue. Good thing that dress doesn't turn back until midnight.

clues.clue: 1980s: A shimmering green tail, a purple seashell top and bright red hair.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ariel! [excited] Fun fact, her red hair was chosen partly so she wouldn't look like a certain blonde movie mermaid of the 80s.

clues.clue: 1990s: A yellow plaid shirt, a black and white cow-print vest, blue jeans and a brown hat.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Woody! Reach for the sky! [chuckles] If you said Jessie, close, but she wears a red hat.

clues.clue: 2000s: A crisp white top and skirt, sky-blue tattoo markings, warm tan skin and snowy white hair. She's royalty from a lost city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kida from 2001's Atlantis: The Lost Empire! Her full name is Kidagakash. [laughs] Try saying that three times fast.

categories.title: Parks Through the Decades
categories.intro: Our Parks category is a grand opening tour. I'll give you the year and a hint, you name the Disney park. [excited] Let's go!

art.prompt: A fairy-tale castle drawn as a timeline from vintage sepia postcard to colorful modern night with fireworks, a monorail, a giant geodesic sphere and a pagoda-roofed harbor along the horizon, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Opened in 1955 in Anaheim, California, it's the only park Walt himself walked through.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disneyland! The happiest place on Earth, and the only one Walt got to see open. [sighs]

clues.clue: Opened in 1971 as the very first park at Walt Disney World.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Magic Kingdom! Opened October 1st, 1971, with Cinderella Castle standing tall over the swamps of Central Florida.

clues.clue: Opened in 1982 under the name EPCOT Center.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Epcot! [chuckles] Big golf ball, BIG ideas, and around the world in eleven pavilions.

clues.clue: Opened in 1983, it was the first Disney park built outside the United States.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tokyo Disneyland! [excited] Konnichiwa, Mickey! Paris didn't arrive until 1992.

clues.clue: Opened in September 2001 in Chiba, Japan, this park is themed to nautical ports of call.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tokyo DisneySea! Many fans call it the most beautiful theme park on the planet. [whispers] I'm not arguing.

categories.title: Which Came First?
categories.intro: The fan category is a time-travel showdown. I'll give you four Disney films. You pick the one that hit theaters first.

art.prompt: Stacks of vintage film canisters and movie reels arranged in a race toward a finish line, a giant golden stopwatch and a hand-painted marquee frame with no words, warm theater lighting, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Which came out first: Dumbo, Frozen, Moana or Encanto?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dumbo! 1941. That little elephant beat Elsa by more than seventy years. [laughs] Respect your elders.

clues.clue: Which came out first: Aladdin, Lilo and Stitch, Ratatouille or Wreck-It Ralph?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aladdin! 1992. A whole new world... and a WHOLE decade before Stitch crash landed.

clues.clue: Which came out first: The Lion King, Toy Story, Pocahontas or Mulan?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Lion King, from 1994! [chuckles] Toy Story and Pocahontas both followed in 1995, and Mulan in 1998.

clues.clue: Which came out first: Peter Pan, Lady and the Tramp, Sleeping Beauty or One Hundred and One Dalmatians?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Peter Pan! 1953, then Lady and the Tramp in 1955, Sleeping Beauty in 1959, and the Dalmatians in 1961.

clues.clue: Which came out first: Pinocchio, Fantasia, Dumbo or Bambi?
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Pinocchio! February 1940, beating Fantasia by nine months. Dumbo flew in 1941 and Bambi in 1942.
